description: tools/list carries the `core` set only; this finds the rest, and every tool is callable whether or not it is listed. No arguments: the toolsets with counts. `query`: words matched against every tool's name, title and description — one line per hit (name · title · toolset). `toolset`: one set in full (build · agents · sell · lab · signet · tasks · about · sponsors). `name`: one tool's complete definition, inputSchema included — call it next. To list a set from connect time put ?toolset=build,signet (or all) on the server URL.

name.description: An exact tool name, e.g. 'rig_author' — returns its full definition.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. 'schedule a rig' or 'paper trade'. Case-insensitive; every word must appear.

toolset.description: A set name: core, build, agents, sell, lab, signet, tasks, about, sponsors, or all.

name: tools_catalog
title: Find any Rokha tool
